snippet.title: Fossil Quest - Itch Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Fossil quest is a cozy fossil digging game where you get to create a dinosaur museum in your home. It's out now and FREE on itch: 
https://unsigneddoublecollective.itch.io/fossil-quest

Travel the world to dig for fossils, come home to assemble the bones, display them and redecorate your museum! 

This game is just a prototype. We would LOVE to turn it into a full game if there is enough interest in the project so if you like it please leave us a comment or a rating on Itch so we can make more things for you! It really helps us tremendously.
